verdict.rationale: Basecamp tracks where work stands through its own Hill Charts and Card Tables, which move work through phases. That covers the status part of the story. The evidence shows nothing for a priority attribute or for assigning an owning team to an initiative; assignment is documented only at the item level. missing for 10: a priority field on initiatives, an owning-team attribute, an initiative-level object or portfolio view of these fields, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track initiatives with status, priority, and an owning team

citations.quote: Basecamp’s Hill Charts let you know exactly where things really stand.
Card Tables are our take on kanban boards. Add cards, set up columns, and move work through phases.
Assign items, set due dates, attach files, even create subtasks.
